name: Shirena Ipucent
source: She was always worried about her sister, who had the same enthusiasm for research, but was a bit of a daredevil, she never did anything reckless. Perhaps because she grew up watching her somewhat selfish older sister, she has a strong sense of self-control and a humble personality. In contrast to her older sister, she seems calm.
